Borrowing is disabled on all reserves and the stable reserves are ~100% utilised (supply < debt), so aWXDAI/aUSDC are not redeemable at par; they are impaired claims, not cash.
The one >=0.909x channel is the off-chain Issuer Buyback Program, currently switched OFF (allow_sell_orders=FALSE) and requiring a whitelisted/KYC'd account plus issuer approval.
